---
title: "附录 C：Wilson 区间图复现"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
params:
  input_csv: "../manuscript/supplementary/comparison_summary.csv"
  figure_dir: "../manuscript/figures"
---

本文件读取已保存的模拟汇总，生成附录 C 的 8 张 PDF 图，**不重新运行模拟**。
程序仅选取 $m=150$、$p\in\{10,40\}$、C1–C4、15 个预设分布配对及下表中的 6 种方法，
共 **2 × 4 × 15 × 6 = 720 个设计单元**。拒绝率和 95% Wilson 区间均从整数拒绝次数
`rejections` 与有效重复次数 `valid` 重新计算，并在写入图形前与保存值核对。

输出文件名为 `wilson_p10_C1.pdf` 至 `wilson_p40_C4.pdf`。
8 张图保持附录 C 原有的分布配对顺序、面板顺序、配色和排版；横轴使用固定线性尺度：
LC 为 0–0.28，其余方法均为 0–0.12。

## 运行与参数

在项目根目录执行：

```r
rmarkdown::render("simulation_reproducibility/04_plot_appendix_C.Rmd")
```

也可在其他工作目录中将本文件的绝对路径传给 `rmarkdown::render()`。
YAML 中的两个路径参数也可通过 `params = list(...)` 覆盖：

| 参数 | 默认值 | 用途 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `input_csv` | `../manuscript/supplementary/comparison_summary.csv` | 已保存的模拟汇总 |
| `figure_dir` | `../manuscript/figures` | 8 张 PDF 的输出目录 |

相对路径均以项目中的 `simulation_reproducibility/` 为基准解析，与启动 R 时的工作目录无关；
也支持绝对路径。输出目录不存在时自动创建；运行会替换其中的同名 PDF。
HTML 报告需要 `rmarkdown`、`knitr` 和 Pandoc；计算与 PDF 绘图仅使用 R 自带功能。

若只需 PDF，可在项目根目录执行以下代码，无需 Pandoc 或 HTML 报告：

```r
code_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".R")
knitr::purl("simulation_reproducibility/04_plot_appendix_C.Rmd",
            output = code_file, documentation = 0, quiet = TRUE)
source(code_file)
```

通过 `purl()` 提取后运行时，工作目录应位于项目内部；程序会向上查找同时包含
`manuscript/` 与 `simulation_reproducibility/` 的项目根目录。

## 定位项目并读取数据

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE)

# Resolve paths from the project, including renders started outside it.
# For purl()/source(), the working directory must be inside the project.
is_absolute <- function(path) {
  grepl("^(/|[A-Za-z]:[/\\\\]|~)", path)
}

absolute_path <- function(path, base = getwd(), must_work = FALSE) {
  path <- path.expand(path)
  if (!is_absolute(path)) path <- file.path(base, path)
  normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = must_work)
}

# Identify the Rmd, sourced script, or Rscript entry point.
current_rmd <- tryCatch(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE),
                        error = function(e) character())
source_files <- unlist(lapply(sys.frames(), function(frame) {
  value <- frame$ofile
  if (is.character(value)) value else character()
}), use.names = FALSE)
command_file <- sub("^--file=", "", grep("^--file=", commandArgs(), value = TRUE))
file_candidates <- c(current_rmd, source_files, command_file)
file_candidates <- file_candidates[nzchar(file_candidates)]
start_dirs <- unique(c(vapply(file_candidates, function(path) {
  dirname(absolute_path(path))
}, character(1)), getwd()))

# Search each candidate directory and its parents for the project layout.
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- absolute_path(start)
  repeat {
    if (dir.exists(file.path(path, "manuscript")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(path, "simulation_reproducibility"))) return(path)
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) break
    path <- parent
  }
  NULL
}

project_roots <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(start_dirs, find_project_root))
if (!length(project_roots)) {
  stop("Cannot locate project root. Render this Rmd by its absolute path, ",
       "or run the extracted R code from within the project.")
}
project_root <- project_roots[[1L]]
script_dir <- file.path(project_root, "simulation_reproducibility")

# Supply defaults when chunks are evaluated without a YAML parameter block.
if (!exists("params", inherits = FALSE)) params <- list()
if (is.null(params$input_csv)) {
  params$input_csv <- "../manuscript/supplementary/comparison_summary.csv"
}
if (is.null(params$figure_dir)) params$figure_dir <- "../manuscript/figures"
input_csv <- absolute_path(params$input_csv, script_dir, must_work = TRUE)
figure_dir <- absolute_path(params$figure_dir, script_dir)
```

```{r read-data}
summary_data <- read.csv(input_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                         check.names = FALSE)
required_columns <- c("m", "p", "covariance", "pair", "method", "alpha",
                      "rejections", "valid", "rejection_rate", "ci_low",
                      "ci_high", "confidence_level")
missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(summary_data))
if (length(missing_columns)) {
  stop("Missing required CSV columns: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
}

# Accept both archived (Chang, Wang) and current (CZZW, WZZ) identifiers.
# Normalize before validating cells so mixed aliases cannot create duplicates.
method_aliases <- c(KyFan_k1 = "KyFan_k1", KyFan_k3 = "KyFan_k3",
                    LC = "LC", CLX = "CLX", Chang = "CZZW", CZZW = "CZZW",
                    Wang = "WZZ", WZZ = "WZZ")
method_order <- c("KyFan_k1", "KyFan_k3", "LC", "CLX", "CZZW", "WZZ")
method_titles <- c("Ky-Fan (k = 1)", "Ky-Fan (k = 3)", "LC", "CLX",
                   "CZZW", "WZZ")
method_description <- c("Ky-Fan, order 1", "Ky-Fan, order 3",
                        "Li and Chen (2012)", "Cai, Liu and Xia (2013)",
                        "Chang, Zhou, Zhou and Wang (2017)",
                        "Wang, Zhu and Zhang (2024)")
method_table <- data.frame(Method = method_titles, Reference = method_description)
knitr::kable(method_table, row.names = FALSE)

# Keep the Appendix C pair and panel order fixed across all figures.
pair_order <- c("N-N", "T-T", "E-E", "G-G", "L-L", "N-T", "N-E", "N-G",
                "N-L", "T-E", "T-G", "T-L", "E-G", "E-L", "G-L")
dimensions <- c(10L, 40L)
covariances <- paste0("C", 1:4)
selected <- with(summary_data,
                 m == 150 & p %in% dimensions & covariance %in% covariances &
                 pair %in% pair_order & method %in% names(method_aliases))
if (anyNA(selected)) stop("Missing design identifiers in the input CSV.")
dat <- summary_data[selected, , drop = FALSE]
dat$method <- unname(method_aliases[dat$method])

# Require the complete 2 x 4 x 15 x 6 design, exactly once per cell.
key_columns <- c("p", "covariance", "pair", "method")
make_key <- function(x) do.call(paste, c(x[key_columns], sep = "|"))
expected <- expand.grid(p = dimensions, covariance = covariances,
                        pair = pair_order, method = method_order,
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (anyDuplicated(make_key(dat))) stop("Duplicate selected design cells.")
if (nrow(dat) != nrow(expected) ||
    !setequal(make_key(dat), make_key(expected))) {
  stop("Selected data must contain exactly 720 design cells (90 per PDF).")
}
if (any(!is.finite(dat$alpha)) || any(abs(dat$alpha - 0.05) > 1e-12) ||
    any(!is.finite(dat$confidence_level)) ||
    any(abs(dat$confidence_level - 0.95) > 1e-12)) {
  stop("The Appendix C figures require alpha = 0.05 and confidence level = 0.95.")
}
```

## 重算并核对 Wilson 区间

设 $n$ 次有效重复中有 $r$ 次拒绝，记 $\widehat q=r/n$、$z=\Phi^{-1}(0.975)$。
95% Wilson 区间为

\[
\frac{\widehat q+z^2/(2n)\ \pm\ z\sqrt{\widehat q(1-\widehat q)/n+z^2/(4n^2)}}
     {1+z^2/n}.
\]

分母采用 `valid` 中的有效重复次数。附录 C 的每个设计单元均应有 1,000 次有效重复，
且无失败。以下代码核对这些条件，并检查保存的拒绝率、区间端点及可用的 MCSE 和条件汇总列；
数值比较的绝对容差为 $10^{-10}$。若检查失败，程序将在替换 PDF 前停止。

```{r validate-wilson}
assert_integer_count <- function(x, name, positive = FALSE) {
  if (any(!is.finite(x)) || any(x != floor(x)) ||
      any(x < if (positive) 1 else 0)) {
    stop(name, " must contain finite ", if (positive) "positive" else "nonnegative",
         " integer counts.")
  }
}
assert_integer_count(dat$valid, "valid", positive = TRUE)
assert_integer_count(dat$rejections, "rejections")
if (any(dat$rejections > dat$valid)) stop("Rejections exceed valid replications.")
if (any(dat$valid != 1000L)) stop("Appendix C requires 1,000 valid replications.")
if ("failed" %in% names(dat) && any(is.na(dat$failed) | dat$failed != 0)) {
  stop("The archived Appendix C subset must have no failed replications.")
}
if ("complete" %in% names(dat) && any(is.na(dat$complete) | !dat$complete)) {
  stop("The archived Appendix C subset must contain only complete cells.")
}
if ("B" %in% names(dat) && any(is.na(dat$B) | dat$B != 1000L)) {
  stop("Appendix C requires the saved B = 1,000 design.")
}

# Recompute every plotted quantity from counts, using the 95% Wilson formula.
z <- qnorm(0.975)
dat$rate_recomputed <- dat$rejections / dat$valid
denominator <- 1 + z^2 / dat$valid
center <- (dat$rate_recomputed + z^2 / (2 * dat$valid)) / denominator
half_width <- z * sqrt(dat$rate_recomputed * (1 - dat$rate_recomputed) /
                        dat$valid + z^2 / (4 * dat$valid^2)) / denominator
dat$lower_recomputed <- pmax(0, center - half_width)
dat$upper_recomputed <- pmin(1, center + half_width)
mcse_recomputed <- sqrt(dat$rate_recomputed * (1 - dat$rate_recomputed) /
                          dat$valid)

# Record agreement with required and optional archived summary columns.
validation <- data.frame(column = character(), max_absolute_difference = numeric())
check_saved <- function(column, calculated, tolerance = 1e-10) {
  if (!column %in% names(dat)) return(invisible(NULL))
  saved <- dat[[column]]
  if (any(!is.finite(saved))) stop("Non-finite saved values in ", column, ".")
  discrepancy <- max(abs(saved - calculated))
  if (discrepancy > tolerance) {
    stop("Saved ", column, " disagrees with counts; max difference = ",
         format(discrepancy, digits = 6), ".")
  }
  validation[nrow(validation) + 1L, ] <<- list(column, discrepancy)
}
for (column in c("rejection_rate", "type1_error_rate", "conditional_rejection_rate")) {
  check_saved(column, dat$rate_recomputed)
}
for (column in c("ci_low", "conditional_ci_low")) {
  check_saved(column, dat$lower_recomputed)
}
for (column in c("ci_high", "conditional_ci_high")) {
  check_saved(column, dat$upper_recomputed)
}
for (column in c("mcse", "conditional_mcse")) check_saved(column, mcse_recomputed)

# Refuse to silently clip an interval against the fixed Appendix C axes.
axis_max <- setNames(c(0.12, 0.12, 0.28, 0.12, 0.12, 0.12), method_order)
if (any(dat$upper_recomputed > axis_max[dat$method] + 1e-12)) {
  stop("An interval exceeds the fixed Appendix C axis limits; inspect the input.")
}
knitr::kable(validation, digits = 16, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Validated", nrow(dat), "cells across", length(dimensions) * length(covariances),
    "figures; valid replications per cell:", paste(unique(dat$valid), collapse = ", "),
    "\n")
```

## 绘制 8 张图

蓝色表示同分布配对，橙色表示异分布配对；竖向虚线标记名义水平 0.05，横向虚线分隔前 5 个
同分布配对与后 10 个异分布配对。每张 PDF 含 6 个面板，按行依次为 Ky-Fan ($k=1$)、
Ky-Fan ($k=3$)、LC、CLX、CZZW、WZZ。区间表示各设计单元的逐点 Monte Carlo 不确定性，
不构成同时置信带。

```{r plot-functions}
draw_wilson_figure <- function(dimension, covariance, destination) {
  grDevices::pdf(destination, width = 160 / 25.4, height = 160 / 25.4,
                family = "Helvetica", pointsize = 9, useDingbats = FALSE,
                title = sprintf("Wilson intervals: p=%d, m=150, %s",
                                dimension, covariance))
  on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(), add = TRUE)
  colors <- c("#21618C", "#D35420")
  y <- 16 - seq_along(pair_order)
  row_colors <- colors[ifelse(seq_along(pair_order) <= 5, 1L, 2L)]
  # Physical panel locations reproduce the original square six-panel layout.
  panel_left <- c(0.061, 0.548)
  panel_right <- c(0.498, 0.986)
  panel_bottom <- c(0.747, 0.456, 0.165)
  panel_top <- c(0.967, 0.676, 0.385)
  for (i in seq_along(method_order)) {
    row <- (i - 1L) %/% 2L + 1L
    column <- (i - 1L) %% 2L + 1L
    method <- method_order[i]
    panel <- dat[dat$p == dimension & dat$covariance == covariance &
                   dat$method == method, , drop = FALSE]
    # Restore the prescribed row order independently of the CSV row order.
    panel <- panel[match(pair_order, panel$pair), , drop = FALSE]
    xmax <- axis_max[method]
    ticks <- seq(0, xmax, length.out = if (method == "LC") 5L else 4L)
    par(fig = c(panel_left[column], panel_right[column],
                panel_bottom[row], panel_top[row]),
        mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), new = i > 1L, xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i",
        mgp = c(0, 0.15, 0), tcl = -0.15, lend = "butt")
    plot.new()
    plot.window(xlim = c(-0.0025 / 0.12 * xmax, xmax * 1.025),
                ylim = c(0.4, 15.6))
    abline(v = ticks, col = "#E0E0E0", lwd = 0.45)
    abline(h = y, col = "#E8E8E8", lwd = 0.4)
    abline(v = 0.05, col = "#333333", lty = "44", lwd = 0.8)
    abline(h = 10.5, col = "#999999", lty = "33", lwd = 0.55)
    segments(panel$lower_recomputed, y, panel$upper_recomputed, y,
             col = row_colors, lwd = 0.7)
    segments(panel$lower_recomputed, y - 0.18, panel$lower_recomputed, y + 0.18,
             col = row_colors, lwd = 0.45)
    segments(panel$upper_recomputed, y - 0.18, panel$upper_recomputed, y + 0.18,
             col = row_colors, lwd = 0.45)
    points(panel$rate_recomputed, y, pch = 16, col = row_colors, cex = 0.66)
    axis(1, at = ticks, labels = sprintf("%.2f", ticks), cex.axis = 0.78,
         col = "#666666", col.axis = "#222222", lwd = 0.45)
    if (column == 1L) {
      axis(2, at = y, labels = pair_order, las = 1, tick = FALSE,
           cex.axis = 0.78, col.axis = "#222222", hadj = 1, line = -0.2)
    }
    box(bty = "l", col = "#888888", lwd = 0.45)
    mtext(sprintf("(%s) %s", letters[i], method_titles[i]), side = 3,
          adj = 0, line = 0.12, cex = 0.96, font = 2)
  }
  # Separate page-level labels keep all panels the same size.
  par(fig = c(0, 1, 0, 1), mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), new = TRUE,
      xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
  plot.new()
  plot.window(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1))
  text(0.54, 0.112, "Empirical Type I error rate", cex = 0.90)
  legend_x <- c(0.064, 0.290, 0.539)
  legend_colors <- c(colors, "#333333")
  segments(legend_x, 0.066, legend_x + 0.030, 0.066,
           col = legend_colors, lwd = 0.8)
  points(legend_x + 0.015, rep(0.066, 3L), pch = 16,
         col = legend_colors, cex = 0.66)
  segments(c(0.539, 0.569), 0.062, c(0.539, 0.569), 0.070,
           col = "#333333", lwd = 0.5)
  text(legend_x + 0.042, rep(0.066, 3L),
       c("Same distribution", "Different distributions", "95% Wilson CI"),
       adj = 0, cex = 0.78)
  segments(0.786, 0.056, 0.786, 0.076, col = "#333333", lty = "44", lwd = 0.8)
  text(0.804, 0.066, "Nominal: 0.05", adj = 0, cex = 0.78)
  text(0.54, 0.029,
       "Axes differ by method; fixed across all eight figures.  m = 150, R = B = 1,000.",
       cex = 0.74)
  invisible(destination)
}
```

```{r export-pdfs}
# All input checks above must pass before any PDF is opened for writing.
if (!dir.exists(figure_dir)) dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE)
if (!dir.exists(figure_dir)) stop("Could not create figure directory: ", figure_dir)
output_files <- character()
for (dimension in dimensions) {
  for (covariance in covariances) {
    destination <- file.path(figure_dir,
                             sprintf("wilson_p%d_%s.pdf", dimension, covariance))
    draw_wilson_figure(dimension, covariance, destination)
    output_files <- c(output_files, destination)
  }
}
stopifnot(length(output_files) == 8L, all(file.exists(output_files)),
          all(file.info(output_files)$size > 0))
knitr::kable(data.frame(Figure = basename(output_files),
                        Bytes = file.info(output_files)$size), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Wrote eight vector PDFs to:", figure_dir, "\n")
```
